company_blurb: Aurora Freight is a Nordic logistics technology provider streamlining cross-border cargo routing and customs freight tracking for mid-market manufacturers and regional carriers across Northern Europe.

departments.culture: The Engineering team values reliable uptime, pragmatic architecture, and peer code reviews. Developers collaborate asynchronously in public channels and keep sprint standups short so everyone has uninterrupted time to ship freight-tracking features.

Finance operates on predictable monthly cadences, clean spreadsheet models, and transparent cost tracking. Analysts and accountants partner closely with operational leads to ground expansion plans in realistic freight margin data.

Legal balances thorough regulatory diligence with practical commercial support. Counsel and compliance staff maintain clear documentation standards so shipping contracts, customs rules, and corporate governance run smoothly.

Sales thrives on fast customer follow-ups, collaborative deal prep, and clear pipeline visibility. The team celebrates new carrier partnerships openly while sharing field feedback to help product teams refine platform workflows.
